Homepage video

Change the video on the public homepage. This setting is shared across all price-list years; prices, carts and order requests are unchanged.

Paste an HTTPS YouTube watch, Shorts or youtu.be link. Leave blank to hide the video. Only use videos you have permission to publish that allow embedding. Portrait Shorts work best; landscape videos keep YouTube's letterboxing.

Yearly price lists

Customers see one active year. Saving changes to the active list updates prices for new requests immediately. Existing orders keep their saved prices. The cart discount remains 15%.

Select a product row to edit its details, effect types, visibility, photos and videos. Choose all applicable effects under Shop by type to help customers filter products. Uncheck Visible to customers when out of stock; recheck it when restocked. Files uploaded to Cloudinary are public; never include private information. Choose Save price list to publish changes. Effect types, visibility, photos and videos are independent for each year.

Price-list products. Select a product to expand editing and media controls. Changes are saved together using Save price list.
